subject: MAP: Hosting & region decision — EuroHealth evaluation & timelines
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Rosales <maria.rosales@eurohealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:18:00 +0100
Subject: Draft MAP + timeline ask — EuroHealth PoC (hosting & region)

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion I’ve attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the evaluation milestones and decision gates for hosting (Hosted EU region vs Dedicated vs Private). High level:

- Week 0–2: PoC on Hosted (EU region) — functional + latency checks
- Week 3–5: Security questionnaire evidence + legal review
- Week 6–8: If PHI/regulatory confirmed, prepare Dedicated proposal and SOW

Can you confirm whether the procurement team needs an NDA or a separate PO before we circulate the SOW? We’re aiming for a final hosting decision by 2026-08-05 so we can kick off onboarding in September.

Attachments: EuroHealth-MAP-v1.3.pdf (MAP), SOW_EuroHealth_v2.docx (draft SOW)

CC’ing Grace and Naomi to capture technical and product constraints.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Maria Rosales <maria.rosales@eurohealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Aline Bergmann <aline@consults.eu>, procure@eurohealth.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 10:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + timeline ask — EuroHealth PoC (hosting & region)

Karthik —

Thanks for the MAP and SOW. A couple of quick clarifying questions from our side before we go deeper:

1) Data residency: Can Hosted in the EU guarantee that inference and logs remain in the EU for the PoC, and would that be contractually guaranteed?
2) PHI / regulated data: If we confirm PHI in scope, how quickly can Redwood provide a Dedicated instance and what are the expected lead times for a Dedicated pool (pricing/commitment)?
3) Evidence: We’ll need SOC2 and encryption-at-rest/process details up front — is there a one-page bundle you can send for procurement?

Procurement looped in (procure@eurohealth.com) and Aline (our external infra consultant) for timeline alignment. We’re targeting an internal decision by 05-Aug so our legal team can review before month-end.

Best,
Maria Rosales
Director, Platform Integrations | EuroHealth Inc
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Rosales <maria.rosales@eurohealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 08:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + timeline ask — EuroHealth PoC (hosting & region)

Hi Maria —

Thanks — quick answers below and a proposed evaluation plan to keep to your 05-Aug decision date.

1) Data residency: Yes — our Hosted EU region processes inference and stores logs in EU regions (Frankfurt and Amsterdam) for customers who select EU tenancy. We can include a contractual clause limiting processing and storage to EU-only endpoints and provide a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) extension scoped to the PoC.

2) If PHI is confirmed:
- Short path (PoC -> Dedicated): we can provision a Dedicated pool in ~3–5 weeks after contract and payment terms are finalized.
- Pricing: Dedicated is priced as a reserved capacity contract; we’ll send a tailored estimate based on throughput in the MAP.

3) Evidence: Attaching a one-page security summary (SOC2 summary + encryption notes) for procurement. Full SOC2 report available under NDA; we can provide it to procurement/legal.

Proposed condensed evaluation plan (to hit 05-Aug decision):
- 27–30 Jul: Functional PoC on Hosted EU (small traffic, latency profiling) — Redwood supplies test keys and region pins
- 30 Jul–03 Aug: Security evidence exchange + legal review (DPA + redlines) — Stephanie will coordinate redlines
- 03–05 Aug: Commercial decision (Hosted continue vs Dedicated commitment)

Next steps: I’ll push the SOW and the MAP (v1.3) into a shared link and Stephanie will follow with legal redlines. Markus, can you confirm Dedicated provisioning lead time if we start approval on 06-Aug?

—
Grace O'Connor
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Rosales <maria.rosales@eurohealth.com>, procure@eurohealth.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 14:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + timeline ask — EuroHealth PoC (hosting & region)

Hi Maria / Procurement —

Attaching a short redline summary and a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) template. Quick notes:
- We can include an EU-only processing clause for the PoC and a clause that Dedicated deployment will run on customer-dedicated GPU pools with stronger isolation guarantees.
- SOC2: available under NDA; I will share the secure link once the procurement team confirms the NDA version.
- DocuSign: I’ve prepared an initial commercial cover page + DPA; link below for signature routing.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/embedded/ABC123

If procurement needs a PO prior to signature we can accept a PO reference and reserve capacity once the commercial terms are agreed.

Regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Maria Rosales <maria.rosales@eurohealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@eurohealth.com, Aline Bergmann <aline@consults.eu>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 15:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + timeline ask — EuroHealth PoC (hosting & region)

Grace / Stephanie —

Thanks — this is helpful. Procurement attached a PO placeholder (will follow formal routing). We’re comfortable proceeding with the Hosted EU PoC under the EU-only processing clause and the DPA you shared; procurement will review the DocuSign flow and SOC2 under NDA.

If PoC performance is within our latency targets we’ll notify you by 05-Aug whether to move forward with Dedicated. Please consider 06-Aug as earliest approval trigger so we can align provisioning timing.

Aline (cc) will coordinate a short checklist with Markus for the PoC runbook.

Best,
Maria
Director, Platform Integrations | EuroHealth Inc
